title: YieldLag: Seasonal Climate Responses and Regional Crop Yield Modelling
description: YieldLag is an R package for regional statistical climate-yield modelling, chronological model comparison, separate interval calibration, seasonal nonlinear responses, prediction decomposition, and paired year-block uncertainty analysis. The software is MIT licensed. Bundled Poland study derivatives retain the source attribution and separate terms in inst/extdata/poland/DATA_LICENSE.md; the MIT license does not apply to provider data. The research scripts retrieve separately licensed external German data and GPL ABSOLUT code without incorporating that code into the R package. Reported studies are retrospective benchmarks and do not establish operational forecast skill, causal effects, or universal model superiority.
